notes: Escribes un ensayo agree / disagree sobre un tema dado.
Debes apoyar tus ideas con argumentos y ejemplos.

tips: Empieza con una frase general sobre el tema (contexto).
Parafrasea la afirmación del enunciado (no la copies).
Termina con tu tesis: di claramente si estás de acuerdo, en desacuerdo o parcialmente de acuerdo, y anuncia tus 2–3 razones.
structure.example: Colombia's healthcare system has changed a lot in recent decades. Some people believe that Colombians will live longer in twenty years. I strongly agree with this idea because medicine is advancing quickly and people are becoming more aware of healthy habits.

tips: Una idea por párrafo, introducida con un conector (Firstly, In addition…).
Frase tema → explicación → ejemplo concreto (dato, experiencia, país, caso).
Cierra el párrafo conectando con tu tesis.
Opcional: un párrafo de contraargumento (Some people argue that… However…).
structure.example: Firstly, medical technology is improving every year. For example, many diseases that used to be deadly, like some types of cancer, can now be treated if they are detected early. As a result, people will probably live longer.

tips: Empieza con In conclusion / To sum up.
Repite tu opinión con otras palabras.
Resume tus razones en una frase. No añadas ideas nuevas.
Opcional: una predicción o recomendación final (¡buen lugar para usar will!).
structure.example: In conclusion, I believe life expectancy in Colombia will be higher in twenty years thanks to better medicine and healthier habits. However, the government will need to invest more in healthcare to make this possible for everyone.

items: A good example of this is …
I agree to some extent, but …
I partly agree with this statement because …
I strongly disagree with the idea that …
It is often said that …; however, …

topics.prompt: "The average life expectancy of Colombians will be higher in 20 years." To what extent do you agree or disagree?
ideas: Más conciencia sobre hábitos sanos (aunque también comida rápida y sedentarismo)
Acceso desigual a la salud entre ciudades y zonas rurales

topics.prompt: "The rise of streaming services like Spotify and Apple Music mean that 'physical' music will disappear in the future." To what extent do you agree or disagree?
ideas: Regreso del vinilo como objeto de colección
Los artistas ganan más con productos físicos y conciertos
Dependencia de internet y de las plataformas

topics.prompt: "Healthcare should be completely free for everyone." To what extent do you agree or disagree?
ideas: Prevención: ahorra dinero a largo plazo

topics.prompt: "The government should ban junk food advertising aimed at children." To what extent do you agree or disagree?
ideas: Libertad de las empresas y de los padres
Ejemplos: impuestos a bebidas azucaradas, etiquetas de advertencia

topics.prompt: "Universities should offer free counselling to all their students." To what extent do you agree or disagree?
"In the future, doctors will be replaced by artificial intelligence." To what extent do you agree or disagree?
ideas: La IA como ayuda, no como reemplazo

topics.prompt: "People today have healthier lifestyles than their grandparents used to have." To what extent do you agree or disagree?
ideas: Antes: más actividad física, comida casera (used to / would)

topics.prompt: "Private health insurance is necessary to receive good medical care." To what extent do you agree or disagree?
ideas: Tiempos de espera en el sistema público
Calidad de hospitales públicos y privados

model.label: Ensayo modelo (escrito para esta página, no está en el PPT)
model.text:
Over the last few decades, Colombians have started to live longer lives. Many people believe that the average life expectancy in Colombia will be higher in twenty years. I agree with this statement to a large extent, mainly because of medical progress and better health policies, although some problems may slow this progress down.

Firstly, medicine is advancing faster than ever. Diseases that used to be deadly, such as some types of cancer, can now be detected early and treated. For instance, many hospitals in Bogotá and Medellín already use modern technology that was not available twenty years ago. As a result, I think doctors will save many more lives in the future.

In addition, people are getting used to living healthier lifestyles. My grandparents would eat fried food every day and they didn't use to exercise. Nowadays, many young people usually go to the gym, ride bikes and follow nutrition guidelines.

On the other hand, access to healthcare is not equal. People in rural areas often have to travel for hours to see a doctor, and many cannot pay for insurance. If the government does not invest in these regions, life expectancy will not improve for everyone.

In conclusion, I believe Colombians will live longer in twenty years thanks to better medicine and healthier habits. However, this will only be true for the whole country if healthcare reaches every region.

checklist: Mi introducción tiene una tesis clara (agree / disagree / partly agree).
Cada párrafo de desarrollo tiene UNA idea principal.
Cada argumento tiene al menos un ejemplo concreto.
La conclusión repite mi opinión sin ideas nuevas.
Usé vocabulario del tema (health / health policy).
Usé gramática del curso: used to / would / be used to / will / will be + -ing.
Revisé concordancia sujeto-verbo y la -s de tercera persona.
Revisé ortografía y puntuación (mayúsculas, comas después de conectores).
